methods.name: Self-attention in non-overlapped windows (W-MSA)
methods.description: Computes self-attention within local, non-overlapping windows arranged to evenly partition the image.

methods.name: Shifted window partitioning
methods.description: Alternates between two partitioning configurations in consecutive Swin Transformer blocks to introduce cross-window connections while maintaining computational efficiency.

methods.name: cyclic implementation
methods.description: A hardware-efficient self-attention computation implementation compared to naive padding, bringing speed-ups particularly for deeper stages.

methods.name: shifted window approach
methods.description: A self-attention computation approach that is more efficient than sliding windows.

methods.name: Swin Transformer block
methods.description: A Transformer block that replaces the standard multi-head self-attention module with a module based on shifted windows, followed by a 2-layer MLP with GELU non-linearity, with LayerNorm applied before each module and residual connections applied after.

methods.name: Shifted Window based Self-Attention
methods.description: A self-attention mechanism designed to avoid quadratic complexity by computing self-attention within non-overlapped windows rather than globally across all tokens.

methods.name: bi-cubic interpolation
methods.description: Used to initialize a model for fine-tuning with a different window size using learnt relative position bias in pre-training

methods.name: Swin-B
methods.description: Base model variant with model size and computation complexity similar to ViT-B/DeiT-B

methods.name: Swin-S
methods.description: Model variant of about 0.5× the model size and computational complexity of Swin-B, similar to ResNet-101

methods.name: Swin-L

methods.name: cyclic-shift
